'''Loddu''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was a low-ranking member of the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]].<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3638 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> when the Cartel [[Conquest of Makeb|annexed]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]], he was tasked with identifying competitors to the Cartel's [[isotope-5]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations. Loddu discovered a team of [[Geologist/Legends|geologists]] who had found rich [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] deposits on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]], and&mdash;unsatisfied with his small share of the profits on Makeb&mdash;sent [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] to capture the geologists and the asteroid,<ref name="Codex" /> later known as [[Mek-Sha]].<ref name="Codex 2">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Huttbreaker's Rebellion}}</ref>

Over the next few [[Standard month/Legends|months]], Loddu transported [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] individuals and [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]] to the asteroid and turned it into a mining station; however, production was slow, leading Loddu to demand&mdash;against his advisors' recommendations&mdash;that [[Bomb/Legends|explosives]] be used to clear areas of the asteroid. The resultant explosion destroyed most of the asteroid, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Loddu and many of the mercenaries and enslaved individuals. In the aftermath, Loddu's sibling, [[Prava]], was forced to take ownership of the station but found that the explosion had uncovered the mineral deposits that Loddu had been seeking.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Loddu was mentioned in "The Hutts Discover Mek-Sha," a Codex entry in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']],<ref name="Codex" /> a [[2019]] Digital Expansion for the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Patch">{{TORweb/Patch|6.0}}</ref>
